data.name: Nuralam
data.gender_notes: Nuralam is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Nura means 'light' and Lam means 'Ram'. This name signifies the divine presence and protection of Lord Ram. The name Nuralam carries the meaning “Light of the God Ram” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nuralam usually hope their child will grow to embody light of the god ram and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrier of the divine light of Lord Ram
data.etymology: Nuralam belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of the God Ram.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuralam total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Kali refers to the Goddess Kali, who is regarded as the goddess of time, creation, destruction, power, and motherhood in Hinduism, and is often depicted with multiple arms, holding a sword and a trishula (a three-pronged weapon). She is also associated with traits like ferocity, both as a destructive force and a protector.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kali holds immense spiritual significance as it represents the goddess of Time, Creator, Destroyer, and Protector, who is an embodiment of Shakti or divine feminine energy. It symbolizes strength, courage, and resilience, and inspires devotion and awe among her followers.
